ALEX MERCER
AI & Machine Learning Engineer | Full Stack AI Developer
Email: alex.mercer@example.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/alex-mercer-ai | GitHub: github.com/torvalds

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Engineered machine learning models and NLP pipelines with 3+ years of experience in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and FastAPI. Built production-ready RAG applications and scalable backend APIs serving 50k+ active users.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Programming: Python, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL
- AI/ML & NLP: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, spaCy, Hugging Face, LLM, RAG, Vector DB
- Frameworks & Web: FastAPI, Flask, React, Node.js, REST APIs
- Databases & Cloud: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS (S3, EC2)
- Tools & DevOps: Git, Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Machine Learning Specialist | NeuralTech Solutions (2023 - Present)
- Designed and deployed custom NLP classification pipeline using Hugging Face Transformers and spaCy, improving intent detection accuracy by 28%.
- Developed high-throughput REST APIs with FastAPI and Redis caching, reducing average response latency from 450ms to 95ms.
- Engineered vector search backend with ChromaDB and RAG architecture for document intelligence enterprise clients.
- Mentored junior engineers and led weekly code reviews.

AI Engineering Intern | DataMind Labs (2022 - 2023)
- Worked on computer vision model optimization for edge devices.
- Responsible for cleaning and preprocessing multi-modal datasets using Pandas and NumPy.
- Helped team integrate PyTorch models into web applications.

PROJECTS
1. Smart CV & Career Profile Analyzer (2024)
   - Built an end-to-end full-stack AI profile scoring engine using spaCy NLP, scikit-learn TF-IDF, and FastAPI backend.
   - Implemented explainable scoring matrix with ATS optimization recommendations and live GitHub API analysis.
   - Tech Stack: Python, spaCy, PyTorch, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.

2. Enterprise RAG Knowledge Graph System (2023)
   - Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system using LangChain, OpenAI API, and PostgreSQL pgvector.
   - Improved query relevance score by 35% on benchmark datasets.
   - Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, Vector DB.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence
Tech University, Graduated 2022 | GPA: 3.8 / 4.0
job_description: We are seeking a senior AI/ML Engineer to design, train, and deploy production ML models and NLP pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, FastAPI, Docker, AWS, and MLOps practices. Experience with LLMs, RAG, and CI/CD pipelines is strongly preferred.
